summary: Metrics classification is incomplete: 5 of 8 failure classes (malformed, oversized, not_found, precondition_failed, internal_error) are never recorded in the production request path, violating the acceptance criterion that metrics classify failures.
defects: backend/src/caldav/http.rs:1508-1550 — dav_server_error, dav_resource_not_found, dav_calendar_not_found, dav_bad_request, and all inline 412 responses (e.g. lines 558, 947, 973, 1338, 1377) never call CaldavMetrics::record_malformed_request/record_oversized_body/record_not_found/record_precondition_failed/record_internal_error. Only auth-path metrics (record_auth_failure, record_rate_limited, record_unauthorized, record_success) are wired into the request flow. Impact: operators cannot distinguish non-auth failure types from metrics; the 5 unused counters are dead code in production, violating the acceptance criterion 'metrics classify failures'.
follow_up: client_key_from_request (http.rs:1976) trusts x-forwarded-for without validating the proxy; acceptable behind a trusted reverse proxy but should be documented as a deployment requirement
No general DAV request rate limit for authenticated users; only auth attempts are throttled. Consider whether a per-user request rate limit is needed for resource exhaustion protection.
important_context: CaldavMetrics is shared via Arc<CaldavMetrics> inside CaldavAccountService; the metrics() accessor (auth.rs:60) exposes it for operator scraping
The 5 unrecorded metric methods exist and are unit-tested in isolation (http.rs:4577-4602) but have no integration test verifying they fire through the request path
